fact_text: Judge a stock index by its P/E ratio rather than its nominal rupee level, and judge national debt as a share of GDP rather than in rupees, since nominal figures make both look elevated.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Oil Prices, Interest Rates & PSX: What Investors Need to Know' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst labels 2002-03, 2013-14, 2021-22 and 2025 as moderate-valuation years on the PSX, with bull phases following the first two and a bear phase after 2021-22.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Oil Prices, Interest Rates & PSX: What Investors Need to Know' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: For a cyclical auto maker, the analyst benchmarks profit and multiples against a moderate-market year; pricing off peak-cycle earnings at a moderate multiple gives a much lower target.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Oil Prices, Interest Rates & PSX: What Investors Need to Know' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: When a stock is priced at a moderate-market multiple during a bull phase, the implied target can sit well below the market price, which the analyst reads as a signal to wait for a reset.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Oil Prices, Interest Rates & PSX: What Investors Need to Know' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst sees no direct link between gold prices and the PSX; gold tends to rise with uncertainty and central bank buying, but an oil-driven war does not normally lift it.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam,'Oil Prices, Interest Rates & PSX: What Investors Need to Know' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: When oil stays expensive, consumers and firms use less of it, so the volume response partly offsets the price rise and the net economic hit is smaller than the price move alone suggests.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Oil Prices, Interest Rates & PSX: What Investors Need to Know' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Without government fuel subsidies, an oil price rise corrects itself through lower demand, so the analyst treats the subsidy decision as the key variable for how long an oil shock lasts.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Oil Prices, Interest Rates & PSX: What Investors Need to Know' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst says even a six-month spell of high oil prices would not by itself end the bull-market framework, provided the government does not keep subsidising fuel.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Oil Prices, Interest Rates & PSX: What Investors Need to Know' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: A global liquidity event, where investors sell broadly, pushes the PSX down on the same day as foreign investors sell; the analyst says the link to Pakistan is only a day or a week long.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Oil Prices, Interest Rates & PSX: What Investors Need to Know' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: A US growth slowdown or rate rise lowers global demand and commodity prices, which benefits Pakistan as long as a conflict is not the thing driving oil prices up.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Oil Prices, Interest Rates & PSX: What Investors Need to Know' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: With strong foreign reserves, Pakistan's domestic interest rates can stay at a reasonable level even when global rates rise, because inflation is not pushed up by currency depreciation.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Oil Prices, Interest Rates & PSX: What Investors Need to Know' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst says one- to two-year PSX returns are set by a few macro indicators, the political backdrop, and whether the market is undervalued or overvalued at the start.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Oil Prices, Interest Rates & PSX: What Investors Need to Know' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: A share price can stay flat even while earnings grow when it had been pushed above a sensible valuation, so the price re-adjusts to the earnings over time.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Oil Prices, Interest Rates & PSX: What Investors Need to Know' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Pakistani companies face high corporate tax rates, yet the analyst notes they still raise profits by expanding at the right point in the business cycle.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Oil Prices, Interest Rates & PSX: What Investors Need to Know' (YouTube transcript, undated)
